pass: Installed skill application to studio controls

findingsTable.before: Unconditional button hover styles in both pages; unconditional link hover in the curiosity study.
findingsTable.after: All local hover rules are inside (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine). Press feedback remains outside that query.
findingsTable.why: Hover is a capability, not a viewport size. Touch does not need to retain a simulated hover state.

findingsTable.before: Background and transform both transitioned for 150ms using an implicit CSS ease. Press and release used identical timing.
findingsTable.after: Only transform transitions: 140ms on press, 100ms on release, cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1). Background changes are immediate.
findingsTable.why: Immediate visible feedback and a faster release, using the supplied curve. Remove the paint-based background transition rather than adding machinery.

findingsTable.before: The studio native select used 14px text; input sizing was not explicit for coarse pointers.
findingsTable.after: Native selects and inputs use 16px under (pointer: coarse). Existing viewport metadata retains user zoom.
findingsTable.why: Address the small-field-text cause of focus zoom without disabling zoom or guessing the device from width.

findingsTable.before: Pressable controls relied solely on the browser default touch-action.
findingsTable.after: Buttons, links, summary, selects, native radios and their control labels use touch-action: manipulation.
findingsTable.why: Permit normal panning and pinch zoom while expressing that those tap targets do not require double-tap zoom delay. Native range gestures remain unchanged.

findingsTable.before: Button and radio-label text could be selected by a long press.
findingsTable.after: Only buttons, summary and radio control labels have user-select: none, with the Safari prefix.
findingsTable.why: Keep controls deliberate while prose, statuses, project context and ordinary links remain selectable/copyable.

findingsTable.before: The new curiosity page generic light hover background could override its primary button fill while its text stayed light.
findingsTable.after: An explicit dark primary hover/active background preserves the intended contrast.
findingsTable.why: Capability gating alone would preserve that source-supported color mismatch; fix the primary control state in the same narrow rule change.

findingsTable.before: Keyboard-focused buttons could inherit the same transform transition as pointer press feedback.
findingsTable.after: Focus-visible buttons keep immediate control feedback with no transform transition. The selected mascot performance is unchanged.
findingsTable.why: Separate frequent UI feedback from the intentionally requested animated content. Keyboard Play must continue to play the film.

retainedByCause.reason: Kept. Not every textual link has a designed alternate active state; suppressing the browser feedback globally would remove useful feedback.

retainedByCause.item: Document scrolling, pinch zoom and text selection
retainedByCause.reason: Kept. These are scrolling review documents, not full-screen app shells or custom gesture canvases. No root overscroll lock, touchmove interception, viewport-fit change or zoom restriction was added.
Kept. The browser owns their input behavior; no custom dropdown, artificial delay or scripted gesture handler was introduced.

retainedByCause.item: Reduced-motion stills and explicit keyboard Play
retainedByCause.reason: Kept. The mascot motion is requested content; the operational UI feedback is a separate scope. Reduced motion remains live and still-first.

validation.source: Reviewed selectors, cascade and exact curve/durations. No layout properties, keyframes, broad transition:all, root selection lock or zoom restriction were added.
validation.browser: Root owns fresh browser evidence; source changes invalidate the earlier UI freeze until rechecked.
validation.hardware: Not tested on physical iOS/Android hardware. Sticky hover, tap latency and focus zoom are source-addressed risks, not measured device outcomes.
validation.performance: Transform-only UI transitions reduce animated property scope; this is not a measured frame-budget or compositor-layer claim.

decision.sourcePatch: Approve for browser verification within the authorized local scope.
decision.productApproval: Not assigned. Hardware comfort and independent specialist approval remain separate.
